article_context: 英国林业与木材行业组织 Confor 警告，长期未充分投资本土生产性林业，使英国高度依赖进口木材；面对建筑和净零需求，政府现有植树激励还不足以保证未来稳定木材供应。

article.title: 阅读 Text 2 · 英国未来建筑木材危机与生产性植树不足
article.background: 英国林业与木材行业组织 Confor 警告，长期未充分投资本土生产性林业，使英国高度依赖进口木材；面对建筑和净零需求，政府现有植树激励还不足以保证未来稳定木材供应。

sentences.en: The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned.
sentences.zh: Confor 警告称，由于没有种植足够的产材林，英国未来将面临建筑业危机。

segments.text: The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned.

sentences.en: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country’s reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
sentences.zh: 这一林业和木材行业组织呼吁立即采取行动，减少英国对进口木材的依赖，并为后代提供稳定的木材供应。

segments.text: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country’s reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.

sentences.en: Currently only 20 per cent of the UK’s wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
sentences.zh: 目前英国所需木材中只有20%产自国内，而英国仍是世界第二大木材净进口国。

segments.text: Currently only 20 per cent of the UK’s wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.

sentences.en: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don’t go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
sentences.zh: 英国政府近期出台新的激励措施，鼓励土地所有者多种树；但该行业组织认为这些措施力度不够，也没有充分宣传通过植树增加木材供应的好处。

segments.text: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don’t go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.

sentences.en: “Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood,” said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor.
sentences.zh: Confor 首席执行官斯图尔特·古德尔说：“我们现在不仅面临碳危机，而且由于没有为生产木材而植树，未来还会面临建筑业危机。”

segments.text: “Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood,” said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor.

sentences.en: “For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall.”
sentences.zh: “几十年来，我们一直没有承担起投资本国木材供应的责任，这使我们暴露在价格波动之下；随着全球需求上升而国内供应下降，我们还将不得不争夺未来的木材供应。”

segments.text: “For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall.”

sentences.en: The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says.
sentences.zh: Confor 表示，英国拥有种植建筑用木材、建设低碳住宅的理想条件，而且在森林可持续经营认证方面处于全球领先地位。

segments.text: The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says.

sentences.en: While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber, the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 per cent.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰约四分之三的住宅使用苏格兰木材建造，而英格兰使用本土木材的比例只有约25%。

segments.text: While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber, the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 per cent.

sentences.en: The causes of the UK’s current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
sentences.zh: 英国之所以陷入当前局面，原因十分复杂，从对生产性林业的过时看法，到灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏，都在其中。

segments.text: The causes of the UK’s current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.

sentences.en: It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects.
sentences.zh: 其中还包括农民和其他土地所有者对投资长期植树项目的明显犹豫。

segments.text: It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects.

sentences.en: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK’s net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 尽管生产性植树能给农村经济带来实际的经济收益，并有助于英国的净零战略，但政府支持的重点仍放在粮食生产，以及单纯为保护生物多样性而进行的本土林地再野化和植树上。

segments.text: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK’s net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.

sentences.en: Goodall added: “While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero.
sentences.zh: 古德尔补充说：“粮食生产和生物多样性健康当然极其重要，但我们的土地还需要为建筑业、制造业提供可靠的木材供应，并为实现净零目标作出贡献。

segments.text: Goodall added: “While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero.

sentences.en: “While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground.
sentences.zh: “尽管英国政府已经表达了增加植树的雄心，但实际行动寥寥。

segments.text: “While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground.

sentences.en: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.”
sentences.zh: Confor 现在呼吁为这些目标注入更强的推动力，以确保我们拥有足够的木材满足不断增长的需求。”

segments.text: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.”
